source.name: Kaizen Gaming: Betano and FC Porto renew partnership until 2029
source.quote: The renewed agreement ensures Betano's continued presence on the front of the official match and training shirts of FC Porto's First Team and B Team.
source.note: Same announcement: 'Betano, Kaizen Gaming's premium online sports betting and gaming brand, will continue as FC Porto's Main Sponsor until the end of the 2028/29 season.'

source.name: Footy Headlines: FC Porto 26-27 Home Kit Released
source.quote: As seen on the back of Rodrigo Mora's shirt beneath the Super Bock sponsor

source.name: FC Porto: FC Porto and XTB announce partnership through 2028/29
source.quote: XTB becomes the Club's new Official Investment Partner and will feature on the sleeve of the men's first-team shirt in all domestic competitions.
source.note: Same announcement: 'FC Porto and XTB have signed a three-year partnership running through the end of the 2028/29 season.'

source.name: FC Porto: A tribute to the 1980s: here is FC Porto’s new 2026/27 kit
source.quote: The new Futebol Clube do Porto kit for the 2026/27 season, once again produced in partnership with New Balance,
source.note: Kit maker; not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense.

summary: New Balance home shirt: Betano on the front, Super Bock on the back, and XTB on the sleeve in domestic competitions. Not marked complete: no cited source lists every placement on the shirt.
